unreleased: Keep the not-found page out of search results: the server answers every unknown address with the app's index.html (status 200), so crawlers saw it as a soft 404. The page now asks not to be indexed, and its description (a missing translation that printed the raw key into the page) is written in Czech and English

Fix a visible seam in the page background on pages taller than the screen: the background gradient repeated, so the dark end of one repeat met the light start of the next. It now covers the first screen once and the page continues in its last colour, in the light and the dark theme

Add a tickets module (src/modules/tickets) for administrators: a list of tickets (search by number, title or requester, filters by status and type, paging) with the mailbox status and a Check mail now button, a form to open a ticket by hand (type, requester, optional CRM partner picker, description), and a ticket page with a header (title, type, total time, requester, partner linked to the CRM, close / reopen), the thread of notes and mails and a form below it: a rich-text editor with pictures, file attachments, the time spent (90, 1:30, 1h 30m) and a switch between an internal note and an e-mail to the requester. A CRM partner's page lists the partner's tickets (a new "crm.partner" slot in the CRM, which the tickets module fills); a header icon links to the tickets for administrators. Czech and English

The content page of a table now has saved filters and statistics. Saved filters are chips above the filter rows: a click puts a filter's conditions, sort and deleted switch on the page, a dot marks a filter you have since changed, and buttons save what you see as a new filter, replace the active one or delete it (a filter that a statistic is based on says which). Statistics are tiles at the top of the page: group the records by one or two fields (text, yes/no, a number, a reference, or a date, date and time or the creation time by day, month or year) and count them or take the sum, average, minimum or maximum of a number, optionally over a saved filter, shown as a table, a chart or both. The editor shows a live preview as you change it. Bar, line and pie charts are drawn without a library in a colour-blind-safe palette with a light and a dark variant: a legend for several series, a tooltip on hover and on keyboard focus (arrow keys on a line chart), a date axis with true spacing, and the neutral colour for records without a value; a table view with the totals is always there, and a pivot table with row and column totals is what two dimensions show. Tiles can be reordered, edited and deleted, hidden statistics are listed below them, and a grid view has a sort control

Add the repository module (src/modules/repository) and make the home page of HomeRepository: a visitor who is not signed in reads what the application is for, a signed-in user sees their repositories as blocks framed in their own colour (name, description, how many tables and records, an Open button) with a New repository button. A repository opens in a page tinted with its colour scheme (eight schemes, each with a light and a dark variant) with its tables as a side menu (a drop-down on phones). A repository has a name, description, a slug made from the name and checked while you type, and a colour scheme, and can be edited and deleted by typing its name. Tables are managed on their own page (create, reorder, delete) and defined in a form with name, description, slug, a table or grid view and a list of attributes: text, number, yes/no, date, date and time, image, reference to a record of another table, and lists and maps of one simple type, each with a description, a required switch and whether it is shown on the content page; a saved attribute's type is locked, and removing one that records hold values for asks for confirmation first. The content page of a table shows its records as a paged table (click a header to sort) or a grid of cards with a cover image, with a quick search, filter rows that fit each field (text, numbers, yes/no, dates, a chosen record, empty / not empty) and a switch for deleted records. A record has a form built from the table's attributes (a picker dialog for references, upload or import from an address for images, rows for the elements of lists and maps, errors shown beside the value they belong to), a card with every attribute, and can be deleted, restored and deleted for good
